main_text.p: que noftri fpiritus & animæ, & corpora criminis expertia conserventur in adventum Domini nostri Iesu Christi, qui nos de manu inimicorum nostrorum liberavit, ut sine timore serviremus ipsi cum sanctitate & justitia coram ipso, cunctis diebus vitæ nostræ: cui sit honor in secula, Amen.
main_text.head: CONCIO LV.
1. Timot. 2.

p.i: O[?]olo igitur orare viros in omni loco sustollentes puras manus, absque ira & disceptatione. Consimiliter & mulieres in amictu modesto, cum verecundia & castitate ornare semetipsas, non tortis crinibus, aut auro, aut margaritis, aut vestitu sumptuoso, sed quod decet mulieres profitentes pietatem per bona opera. Mulier in silentio discat cum omni subjectione. Caterum mulieri docere non permitto, neque authoritatem usurpare in viros, sed esse in silentio. Adam enim prior formatus est, deinde Eva. Et Adam non fuit deceptus, sed mulier seducta, obnoxia facta est transgressioni: salva tamen fiet per generationem

page.notes: The woodcut initial at the start of the italic paragraph is decorative; the first word is read as "Olo" with a doubtful first letter, most likely V (Volo, 1 Tim. 2:8), marked [?]. "Consimiliter" is read with some doubt in the word-start letters. Small pen-like marks in the right margin and along the lines are not printed text and are left out. The page ends mid-sentence ("per generationem"), so the paragraph continues on the next page.
